---
title: element-line
subtitle: "Line element: colour and thickness."
category: Themes
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Pass the result to [`theme`](theme.qmd) under keys like `panel-grid` or `axis-line`.

## Usage

```typst
element-line(
  colour: none,
  thickness: none,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `colour` | `none` | Line colour, or `none` to inherit. |
| `thickness` | `none` | Line thickness (a Typst length), or `none`. |

## Returns

Element dictionary consumed by [`theme`](theme.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/element-line-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 10).map(i => (x: i, y: i * 0.5))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  theme: theme(panel-grid: element-line(colour: rgb("#d9cfbf"))),
)
```

[`theme`](theme.qmd), [`element-text`](element-text.qmd), [`element-rect`](element-rect.qmd), [`element-blank`](element-blank.qmd).
